He seems unreal, and I've spent some time trying to figure out if he's anything other than what he appears to be. He has plenty of money, but he spends it on buying gifts for people and volunteering everywhere, almost every day. Half the year he spends down here, and the other half of the year up north, and in both places, he fills his days with volunteer work. He's obsessed with Christmas stuff and puts together big displays every year, and even donates and decorates the venues he visits. Never seen him really mad, always good-natured. Every year, at Christmastime, before he heads back up north, he bakes thousands of cookies, all from scratch, presumably with friends. I said I was a little something quiet with my housemates. He gave me three homemade scratch fruit and nut breads, all nicely wrapped in foil and saran wrap, and labelled, on a silver tray. I still don't think I could do it, but if I had to kill five random innocent (to my knowledge) strangers for someone, it'd probably be him.
